take_homes: Use one agent if one is enough. Use more only when they need different access, a different source, or an opposing view.
When work passes between agents, numbers and details can get lost, and nobody checks if the final answer is true. A person has to check.
An agent can send a message or reach other systems, so it must ask first and its access must be limited.
